subject.title: Bookstore Project - Database Normalization & Django Web Interface
details: Bookstore Project - Database Normalization & Django Web Interface (https://github.com/RossJiao/bookstore-project): Refactored Bookstore database to Third Normal Form (3NF). Created authors table with first_name, last_name, bio, birth_year. Created book_authors association table for many-to-many relationship. Added publisher and quantity_on_hand to books table. Split orders into orders header and order_details tables. Changed order_id to numeric primary key with order_number as business key. Added NOT NULL constraints on all non-key columns.

Built Django web interface: Created search page supporting title, author (first/last name), and genre search. Created order page with form for name, email, quantity, and mobile. Integrated stock management (auto-deduct on order). Admin panel for managing books, authors, and orders.

Imported 50 books from Open Library API using custom management command. Updated dbdiagram.io ERD to match new database schema. Deployed development server and tested end-to-end flow. Added README with setup instructions.
MIT 6.0001 Python Lectures: Completed Lectures 1 through 16.

notes: Database normalization eliminates data redundancy and allows multiple authors per book.
Django search uses Q objects for multi-field searching.
Orders are stored with header/details pattern for scalability.
Stock updates automatically when orders are placed.
Email sending causes a few seconds delay (needs async improvement).
